reproduction.method: Gaussian maximum-likelihood factor analysis via EM with diagonal uniquenesses
reproduction.description: Fit a two-factor heteroscedastic latent Gaussian model and visualize actual posterior scores and loadings.
differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
220×6 standardized two-factor observations replace cars04 387×11 continuous measurements.
A direct EM likelihood fit replaces the factoran toolbox; no varimax rotation or interactive variable labels.
Initialization uses covariance eigenvectors, but all subsequent updates optimize the FA marginal likelihood with separately estimated diagonal uniquenesses, not PCA.
